title: FASTFACT: Faster, Stronger Long-Form Factuality Evaluations in LLMs
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating the factuality of LLM outputs against web-retrieved evidence. While it discusses the scope of factuality through an epistemological lens and uses examples related to epistemology (e.g., a priori knowledge) to illustrate claim extraction failures in the appendix, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, ethics, or morals as a core component.
